rebuttal_response: P01-QA-001 is resolved: v3 supplies literal commands or sufficiently exact inspection procedures, exit statuses, material outputs, and supported conclusions for Tests 1–5. P01-QA-003 is partially resolved because §2 now inventories individual paths and moves, but its post-change-status component remains unresolved.

findings.title: The reported git status is not the post-change status of the judged artifact
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 6: “It includes the post-change git status.”
findings.trigger: The status in §6 is compared with the working tree containing the v3 artifact submitted for this round.
findings.consequence: The report presents a known earlier snapshot rather than the checkpoint state being judged, so reviewers cannot use it as the required post-change status.
findings.evidence: Section 6 lists `P01_checkpoint_report.v2.md` at the active path and omits both active `P01_checkpoint_report.v3.md` and `deprecated/P01_checkpoint_report.v2.md`, expressly explaining that those changes occurred after the command. Actual `git status --short --untracked-files=all` now contains v3 at the active path, v2 under `deprecated/`, and round-03 QA files. Thus the displayed output is not post-change status for v3.

observations: The individual path inventory in §2 fixes the directory-collapsing portion of the prior finding.
The supplied v3 SHA-256 matches the file on disk.
The exact-command deficiency from round 2 is fixed, including the wheel leakage check, control build, reproducibility comparisons, and rollback commands.
The report correctly withholds a Test 6 PASS and final completion claim pending this independent gate.
reasoning: The history accurately reflects my two prior verdicts. Most round-2 defects are now corrected. One explicit Criterion 6 requirement still fails: the report labels a pre-v3 snapshot as its complete post-change status while acknowledging subsequent artifact and move operations that make it stale.
